CL_ASMTR2025.to: AP, RSE, RGE, RI, RGBC, RSC, RMWC
CL_ASMTR2025.status_note: Encouragement superseded by the mandatory requirement from 1 Dec 2026 鼓勵性質，已由 2026 年 12 月 1 日起的強制要求取代
points: GEO (CEDD) launched **SmartCheck** (Dec 2025), a pilot web system that reads **standardised material test reports with an encoded digital signature and QR code** and checks results against acceptance criteria automatically.
土木工程拓展署土力工程處於 2025 年 12 月推出試行系統 **SmartCheck**，透過二維碼及數碼簽署自動讀取**標準化物料測試報告**並核對接受準則。
Initially for **concrete cube and core strength** and **steel reinforcing bar** tests. All stakeholders are **encouraged** to submit digitally signed standardised reports.
初期涵蓋**混凝土立方體及芯強度**及**鋼筋**測試；鼓勵各方提交附數碼簽署的標準化報告。

CL_RBGAOBD2025.to: AP, RSE, RGE, RI, RGBC, RSC, RMWC
points: Annual reminder before Christmas and Chinese New Year: **do not offer gifts or advantages of any kind** to BD officers. Government regulations forbid acceptance; offering may lead to action against the sender and the receiver.
聖誕及農曆新年前的每年提示：**不得向屋宇署人員饋贈任何禮物或利益**；政府規例禁止接受，送禮者及收禮者均可能被追究。

CL_UFRPNSTPSFBCDAARMWAPRSERGERI2025.status_note: One-off reporting exercise (deadline 4 Dec 2025); requirements now in PNRC 85 一次性申報（2025 年 12 月 4 日截止），規定已納入 PNRC 85
points: After the **No. 5 alarm fire at Wang Fuk Court, Tai Po (26 Nov 2025)** involving bamboo scaffolds and protective nets: review the fire retardant properties of **nets, screens, tarpaulins and plastic sheeting** on facades of all works under your charge (construction, demolition, A&A, repair, minor works).
**大埔宏福苑五級火（2025 年 11 月 26 日）**後：須檢視所負責工程外牆的**保護網、保護幕、防水布及膠布**的阻燃性能。

Submit **one report per project** with certificates, test or assessment reports from accredited laboratories, showing compliance with recognised standards and good condition, **within 7 days (by 4 Dec 2025)**, by hand or to frm_submission@bd.gov.hk. BD audits and acts on non-conformities.
每個項目提交**一份報告**，附認可實驗所證書或測試報告，於 **7 日內（2025 年 12 月 4 日前）**遞交；屋宇署會抽查並採取行動。

CL_UFRPNSTPSFBCDAARMWRC2025.status_note: One-off reporting exercise (deadline 4 Dec 2025); requirements now in PNRC 85 一次性申報，規定已納入 PNRC 85
points: Same requirement as the letter to AP/RSE/RGE/RI of the same date, addressed to **registered contractors**: report on fire retardant properties of facade protective materials with laboratory evidence **by 4 Dec 2025**.
與同日致認可人士等的通告相同，對象為**註冊承建商**：於 2025 年 12 月 4 日前提交外牆保護物料阻燃性能報告。

CL_ATGMWCS2025.to: AP, RSE, RGE, RI, RGBC, RSC, RMWC
CL_ATGMWCS2025.status_note: Incorporated into the MW Technical Guidelines (Oct 2025) 已納入小型工程技術指引
points: Amends **TG Section 11.2.10**: all protective nets, screens, tarpaulins and plastic sheeting covering external walls and scaffolds must have suitable **fire retardant** properties meeting recognised standards, e.g. **GB 5725-2009** (formerly GB 16909-1997), **BS 5867-2:2008 Type B**, **NFPA 701:2019 Test Method 2**, or equivalent.
修訂技術指引 **11.2.10 節**：所有外牆及棚架的保護網等須具**阻燃**性能，符合認可標準，例如 **GB 5725-2009**、**BS 5867-2:2008 B 類**、**NFPA 701:2019 方法 2** 或同等標準。

CL_UFRPNSTPSFBCDRMW2025.to: AP, RSE, RGE, RI, RGBC, RSC, RMWC
CL_UFRPNSTPSFBCDRMW2025.status_note: In force; standards later set out in PNRC 85 (Dec 2025) 有效；標準其後列入 PNRC 85
points: After a **No. 3 alarm fire (18 Oct 2025)** on bamboo scaffolds at a building under A&A and minor works: **inspect at once** that facade protective materials are fire retardant to recognised standards.
**2025 年 10 月 18 日三級火**後：須**即時檢查**外牆保護物料符合阻燃標準。

Requirements listed: **FS Code F5.6(e)**; **Demolition Code para 3.3.2**; **APP-70 para 4(a)**; **PNRC 26 para 4(a)**; circular of **21 Mar 2023**; Bamboo Scaffold Guidelines **para 6.15 Part C**; Labour Department CoP for Bamboo Scaffolding Safety **para 4.4.4**; CIC Safety Message 24/25. Non-compliance may lead to prosecution and disciplinary action.
相關規定：消防安全守則 F5.6(e)；拆卸守則 3.3.2 段；APP-70 第 4(a) 段；PNRC 26 第 4(a) 段；2023 年 3 月 21 日通告；竹棚架指引 C 部 6.15 段；勞工處竹棚架守則 4.4.4 段。違者或被檢控及紀律處分。

CL_PMCSTR2025.to: AP, RSE, RGE, RI, RGBC, RSC, RMWC
CL_PMCSTR2025.status_note: One-off (Severe Tropical Storm Ragasa, Sep 2025) 一次性（2025 年 9 月颱風樺加沙）
points: Urgent measures before **Ragasa (樺加沙)**: scaffold ties at the top, ≤ one floor above the topmost floor, bracing and brackets, **remove screens/tarpaulins** and lower scaffolds to ≤ half a floor when signals are up, no loose materials, dismantle completed scaffolds; tower crane and gondola precautions as in the annual rainy-season letter (16 Apr 2025).
**樺加沙**來襲前的緊急措施：棚架頂部拉結、高出頂層不多於一層、懸掛信號時**拆除保護幕**並降至半層、清走物料；塔式起重機及吊船措施同 2025 年 4 月 16 日通告。

CL_GRDNBMRPCMCDS2025.to: AP, RSE, RGE, RI, RGBC, RSC, RMWC
points: Annual rodent-proofing design and site mosquito/rodent guidelines; same content as the 2026 letter (rodent disinfestation ≥ 3 months before completion; 6 mm gap rules).
每年防鼠設計及地盤防蚊防鼠指引，內容與 2026 年版相同。

Many **late MWIS submissions**. Statutory timeframes under **B(I&R)R s 14**: **WI 1** (same QP for inspection and repair) – within **14 days** after inspection if no repair, or after repair; **WI 2** (different QPs) – within **7 days** after inspection; **WI 3** – within **14 days** after repair.
強制驗窗**遲交**情況普遍。**B(I&R)R 第 14 條**時限：**WI 1**（同一合資格人士）檢驗後（無需修葺）或修葺後 **14 日**內；**WI 2**（不同人士）檢驗後 **7 日**內；**WI 3** 修葺後 **14 日**內。
Forms with irregularities are **rejected** (Appendix: address not matching the notice, missing names or signatures, wrong dates). Prosecution or disciplinary action possible. Use e-Forms.
有錯漏的表格會被**退回**（附錄列出常見錯誤）；可被檢控或紀律處分；鼓勵用電子表格。

HKIC and IVE continue the **refresher course** for RMWC renewal or restoration. Without a job reference for at least one relevant minor works item, the application goes to the **MWCRC interview** (PNRC 69 App. O para 1(a), App. D para 6).
建造業議會及 IVE 繼續提供小型工程承建商**重溫課程**；續期或恢復註冊時如無最少一項相關工程記錄，須接受**委員會面見**。
Exemption from interview if the course was completed **within 3 years** before applying; not available after a failed interview, or with convictions, disciplinary records or public works suspension.
申請前 **3 年內**完成課程可免面見；面見失敗、有定罪、紀律記錄或被暫停投標者不適用。
HKIC **CPD course** for RGBC/RSC renewal or restoration. Interview by CRC only if **inactive** (no job reference on one relevant project, PNRC 38 App. M) or new incidents (PNRC 38 App. J).
建造業議會為一般建築及專門承建商提供**持續專業發展課程**；只有**不活躍**或有新事故時才需委員會面見（PNRC 38）。
Inactive contractors who completed the course **within 3 years** may be exempted from interview; not for those with convictions, disciplinary records, suspension, or a failed interview.
不活躍承建商如 3 年內完成課程可免面見；有定罪等記錄或面見失敗者不適用。

CL_PMCSRTS2025.to: AP, RSE, RGE, RI, RGBC, RSC, RMWC
points: Annual rainy and typhoon season measures for sites (scaffolds, tower cranes, flood prevention); same structure as the 2026 letter.
每年雨季及颱風季節地盤措施（棚架、塔式起重機、防洪），內容與 2026 年版相若。

CL_EASSSSQSATBWIMPTC2025.to: AP, RSE, RGE, RI, RGBC, RSC, RMWC
CL_EASSSSQSATBWIMPTC2025.status_note: Incorporated into APP-162 and PNRC 80 已納入 APP-162 及 PNRC 80
points: Extends the 2024 requirement: from **1 July 2025**, projects with estimated building works cost **> $30 million** get **BO s 17(1) item 6** conditions requiring qualified supervision by the **Mobile Plant Alert System** and **Tower Crane Alert System** (4S) for **all types** of works using mobile plants or tower cranes – demolition, site formation, ELS, foundations, pile caps and superstructure.
擴大 2024 年要求：由 **2025 年 7 月 1 日**起，工程造價 **超過 3,000 萬元**的項目，凡涉及流動機械或塔式起重機的**所有類別**工程（拆卸、地盤平整、挖掘支撐、地基、樁帽、上蓋），均按《建築物條例》第 17(1) 條附加條件，須以**流動機械警報系統**及**塔式起重機警報系統**作合資格監督。
Imposed on the **first approval** or major revision of plans and/or the **first consent**; also A&A projects with structural works above the threshold. Details in revised **APP-162** and **PNRC 80**.
於**首次批准**／重大修訂及／或**首次同意**時附加；涉及結構工程而達門檻的加建改建項目亦適用。

**Plate load tests by videotelephony**: extends the 2 Jun 2023 arrangement for pile proof load tests. Whole test under RSE and RSC supervisory teams; App. I: at least **one or 50 %** of the tests (whichever more) witnessed **on site** by BD; **TCP T5 (RSE)** and **TCP T4 (RSC)** present; trial video beforehand; video (≥ **480p**) on DVD certified by RSE and the RSC AS within **7 days**; video shows site features, test location, supervisors and HOKLAS lab staff.
**以視像方式見證平板荷載測試**：伸延 2023 年 6 月 2 日樁荷載測試安排。附錄 I：最少 **1 次或 50%**（以較多者為準）須由屋宇署**到場**見證；結構工程師 T5 及承建商 T4 須在場；事先試播；錄影（≥ 480p）於 7 日內提交並經核證。

**Streamlined witnessing of test installation of piles** (not for **sensitive sites**): for socketed H-piles and mini-piles BD checks only at the **bedrock drilling** stage (supervisors present, setting out, casing size and position, hole depth, rock fragments); for driven H-piles at the **final set** stage (setting out, pile type and size, hammer, drop height, blow count). App. II: TCPs do pre-bedrock inspection with videos and photos (plant, advance rate, casing verticality, air pressure, flushing).
**簡化見證試樁**（**敏感地盤**除外）：嵌岩工字樁及微型樁只於**鑽岩階段**查核；打入式工字樁只於**最後貫入度**階段查核。附錄 II：技術人員須於鑽岩前階段自行檢查並錄影拍照。

**Proof test pile selection on Form BA14**: APP-18 (Oct 2024) measures – BA14 after **≥ 85 %** interface proof drilling for large bored piles and deferring 28-day cube results – extended to other bored foundation types. BD selects piles once essential information is in; later documents allowed (excavation records, monitoring, sonic tests, 28-day cubes if earlier cubes justify, mill certificates, proof drilling ≥ 85 %). BA14 acknowledged only when all results are satisfactory.
**BA14 選樁作驗證測試**：APP-18（2024 年 10 月）的措施（大直徑鑽孔樁完成 **85%** 介面鑽探即可交 BA14、延後提交 28 日立方體結果）伸延至其他需鑽岩的樁型；部分文件可稍後提交；全部結果滿意後才確認 BA14。

CL_TGMWCS2024E2025.to: AP, RSE, RGE, RI, RGBC, RSC, RMWC
CL_TGMWCS2024E2025.status_note: Promulgates the TG (2024 Edition), later amended Oct 2025 and Aug 2026 頒布技術指引 2024 年版（其後於 2025 年 10 月及 2026 年 8 月修訂）
points: Promulgates the **Technical Guidelines on Minor Works Control System (2024 Edition)**, consolidating addenda 1/2012, 1/2014, 11/2014, 1/2015, 1/2020 and amendments 3/2021, 10/2021, with the Technical Committee's advice.
頒布**《小型工程監管制度之技術指引》（2024 年修訂版）**，整合以往增補及修訂。

Changes: more interpretations (1.3); legislative amendments (1.4); statutory procedures (2, 4.3–4.6); 2020 new items and designated exempted works (3, 6); clarifications – **PV panel supports** (3.2.1), grease traps and manholes (3.3), skylight glass (3.4.1), slab openings for internal stairs (3.10, 3.25), backfilling (3.18.1), screeding in flats (3.28.1), spare glass panes (3.32.5–3.32.10); **Signboard and Minor Amenity Feature Validation Schemes** (7); departmental comments (9–14).
主要修訂：釋義、法例修訂、法定程序、2020 年新增項目、**光伏板支架**、隔油池及沙井、天窗玻璃、內部樓梯樓板開洞、回填、單位內批盪、後備玻璃；新增**招牌及小型適意設施檢核計劃**指引。

CL_SCIITC2025.to: AP, RSE, RGE, RI, RGBC, RSC, RMWC
points: Appeal to subscribe to the **Construction Industry Integrity Charter 2.0** (DEVB, ICAC, CIC), extending the 2021 Charter from contractors to **consultants**, and to implement an **Integrity Management System**.
呼籲簽署**《建造業誠信約章 2.0》**（發展局、廉署、建造業議會），範圍由承建商擴展至**顧問**，並推行誠信管理系統。

CL_PMPBSTR2025.status_note: One-off (Ragasa, Sep 2025) 一次性（颱風樺加沙）
points: Before **Ragasa**: protect exposed glazing and lock windows and curtain wall sashes; secure gondolas; cordon off tree-fall zones; check external projections (scaffolds, signboards, PV panels); clear roof and basement drains; pumps in flood-risk areas; inspect slopes and retaining walls.
**樺加沙**來襲前：保護玻璃並鎖好窗；固定吊船；封閉塌樹範圍；檢查外牆裝置；清理排水；備抽水設備；巡查斜坡。
Annual typhoon season reminder to property managers (same items as the 2026 letter).
每年颱風季節對物業管理公司的提示，內容與 2026 年版相同。
Annual bamboo scaffold safety reminder to property managers (same items as the 2026 letter).
每年竹棚架安全提示，內容與 2026 年版相同。
